answer_constraint: Give only the recommendation. Do not explain.

conditions.description: Primary deontological stance using duties, rights, promises, and constraints.
conditions.instruction: Answer as someone whose recommendation is guided by duties, rights, promises, and moral constraints. Give only the recommendation. Do not explain.

conditions.description: Positive variant using commitments, boundaries, and standing constraints.
conditions.instruction: Answer as someone who gives priority to commitments, boundaries, and what must not be done even when another outcome is tempting. Give only the recommendation. Do not explain.

conditions.description: Primary utilitarian stance maximizing aggregate welfare.
conditions.instruction: Answer as someone whose recommendation maximizes overall welfare across everyone affected. Give only the recommendation. Do not explain.

conditions.description: Positive variant prioritizing largest net benefit even when individual claims are sacrificed.
conditions.instruction: Answer as someone who gives priority to the largest net benefit across all people affected, even when individual claims are sacrificed. Give only the recommendation. Do not explain.

conditions.description: Primary virtue-ethics stance using character traits.
conditions.instruction: Answer as someone whose recommendation reflects what a person of good character (honest, courageous, just, prudent) would do. Give only the recommendation. Do not explain.

conditions.description: Positive variant emphasizing stable disposition over rules or consequences.
conditions.instruction: Answer as someone who gives priority to acting from a stable disposition of integrity rather than calculating consequences or following rules. Give only the recommendation. Do not explain.

conditions.description: Primary contractualist stance using justifiability to all affected.
conditions.instruction: Answer as someone whose recommendation could be justified to everyone affected on grounds no one could reasonably reject. Give only the recommendation. Do not explain.

conditions.description: Positive variant using fair principles all affected could agree to.
conditions.instruction: Answer as someone who gives priority to fair principles that all those affected could agree to, even if a different outcome is more efficient. Give only the recommendation. Do not explain.

conditions.description: Default recommendation-only pole with no theory content.
conditions.instruction: Give your recommendation. Do not explain.

conditions.description: Length-matched neutral pole controlling for instruction-length asymmetry without adding framework content.
conditions.instruction: Read the situation carefully. Take a moment to consider the full set of people and factors involved. Give your recommendation. Do not explain.

conditions.description: Explicit non-deontological suppression pole; diagnostic only.
conditions.instruction: Give your recommendation without treating duties, rights, promises, or moral constraints as decisive. Do not explain.

conditions.description: Explicit non-utilitarian suppression pole; diagnostic only.
conditions.instruction: Give your recommendation without treating overall welfare or aggregate outcomes as decisive. Do not explain.

conditions.description: Explicit non-virtue-ethics suppression pole; diagnostic only.
conditions.instruction: Give your recommendation without treating character traits or virtues as decisive. Do not explain.

conditions.description: Explicit non-contractualist suppression pole; diagnostic only.
conditions.instruction: Give your recommendation without treating what could be justified to all affected parties as decisive. Do not explain.
